content: Official Zoom, Epic Pen, and ScreenBrush materials indicate mature interaction patterns: separate pen/highlighter semantics; object tools for lines, arrows, rectangles, ellipses, and text; erasing individual strokes plus clear-all; undo/redo; formatting for color, width, font; a pointer or mouse mode to stop intercepting input; and customizable shortcuts. Temporary or vanishing ink is a deliberate teaching/presentation mode. ScreenBrush adds Ghost Mode (overlay remains above the app while normal interaction passes through), editable/selectable layers, snapshots, cursor halo, flashlight/magnifier, and whiteboard mode. These patterns should inform discoverable toolbar behavior and explicit mode state.
